module: GE extension `core_paths`: management of camera paths (*.camPath.json files) used by the 'path' camera and by the path editor. It loads, creates, saves and deletes paths, plays them via core_camera, and provides the evaluation of transform tracks (position, orientation, FOV) with temporal Bezier curves. When a level starts, it loads all camPaths from the `camPaths` folder next to the level file.
usage:
local p = core_paths.loadPath('/levels/gridmap_v2/camPaths/intro.camPath.json')
if p then core_paths.playPath(p, 0) end
-- later
core_paths.stopCurrentPath()
notes: A path is a table { name, markers = {...}, looped, loopTime, filename, id, dirty, manualFov, transformTracks, advancedMode, replay }. Each marker has pos (vec3), rot (quat), time, fov, positionSmooth, bullettime, cut, movingStart, movingEnd, trackPosition, attachToVehicle, trackOffset, plus the Bezier families <prefix>In/Out/InTime/OutTime.

On save, pos and rot are converted to {x,y,z[,w]} tables, the written version is "6", and default values (positionSmooth 0.5, Bezier 1 and 1/3, bullettime 1) are removed to keep files compact. savePath does not handle a nil marker.pos or marker.rot.

loadPath reuses an already loaded path with the same `filename`. It flips the sign of a quaternion if the dot product with the previous one is negative (avoids the long way around). It does not check that `markers` exists in the JSON.

Transform tracks (transformTracks) are lists of keys { t, v, slopeIn, slopeOut, timeIn, timeOut } per channel (see transformChannels). The yaw and roll angles are in degrees, interpolated by the shortest path when looping.
A `cut` marker is a hard jump: the keys before and after the cut are not interpolated between each other.

getPath (old, named getPath_Deprecated in the code) reads a SimPath object from the scene, not a camPath file; with no argument it takes the first SimPath. It returns nothing if no SimPath exists. Loop `for i = 0, res.nodeCount`: iterates one index more than the number of nodes (inferred from code).
onClientStartMission: replaces the path list; duplicate names get a '(n)' suffix. It crashes if loadPath returns nil for a file (path.name on nil).

motionPrefixes.desc: Temporal Bezier families: 'motion' (position), 'rotMotion' (whole orientation), then 'yawMotion', 'pitchMotion', 'rollMotion' (one Euler axis each).

transformChannels.desc: Transform track channels: posX, posY, posZ, yaw, pitch, roll, fov.

invertCubicBezier.desc: Inverse of a monotonic cubic Bezier x(t) = cubicBezier(a, b, t) on [0, 1], by Newton (8 iterations). Exact at the bounds: u<=0 gives 0, u>=1 gives 1.

loopDuration.desc: Duration of a path's loop transition: 0 if the path is not `looped`, otherwise loopTime (min 0), or 2 s if loopTime is absent.

evalTransformTrack.desc: Evaluates a track of keys { t, v, ... } at time t by Bezier interpolation between keys, handling cuts and wrapping (wrap).

wrap.desc: { duration, fromT, unwrapDeg } for the end transition to the first key.

returns.desc: Value, or nil if the track is empty or t is nil.

cloneTransformTracks.desc: Clean copy of the transform tracks, keeping only the channels of transformChannels and the fields t, v, slopeIn, slopeOut, timeIn, timeOut.

returns.desc: Copy, or nil if tracks is not a table.

evalTransform.desc: Evaluates all channels (pos, yaw/pitch/roll, fov) of the path at time t.

returns.desc: Table channel -> value; nil if the path has no tracks or if no channel gives a value.

getUniquePathName.desc: Returns a name not used by the loaded paths: the name as is, otherwise with a numeric suffix (name1, name2...).

getMarkerIds.desc: Returns the 4 marker indices (previous, current, next, next+1) used to interpolate segment idx. Handles looping (modulo) and cuts (`cut`), which duplicate the neighboring index.

idx.desc: Index (1-based) of the segment's start marker.

addPath.desc: Adds a path to the list and assigns it the smallest free id (path.id field modified).

createPath.desc: Creates an empty path { name, markers = {}, manualFov = true, dirty = true } and adds it.

deletePath.desc: Removes from the list the first path with the same name as the given one. Does not delete any file.

getPaths.desc: Returns the internal table of loaded paths (not a copy).

getEndIdx.desc: Index of the last playable segment: number of markers if the path loops, otherwise number minus 1.

savePath.desc: Writes the path to a JSON file (version 6) and updates cameraPath.filename and dirty = false.

loadPath.desc: Loads a path from a camPath.json file and adds it to the list; returns the existing path if that file is already loaded.

pathFileName.desc: File to read; nil returns nil.

returns.desc: The path, or nil if the file is not found (error in the log).

getPath.desc: Old function (getPath_Deprecated): reads a SimPath from the scene and returns its markers. With no argument, takes the first SimPath of the level.

returns.desc: { markers, looped, nodeCount }, or nil if not found.

playPath.desc: Plays a path with the 'path' camera (core_camera.setByName(0, 'path', ...)). initData receives useJsonVersion, hasIntro, path, offset, and default reset/getNextPath.

offset.desc: Start offset (0 by default; unit inferred: seconds).

initData.desc: Extra options for the camera; modified in place.

stopCurrentPath.desc: If the active camera is 'path', switches to the free camera (commands.setFreeCamera).

onClientStartMission.desc: Hook called when a level starts: clears the list and loads all *.camPath.json files from the 'camPaths' folder next to the level file.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads; does nothing.

onSerialize.desc: Save hook before Lua reload: returns a deep copy of the paths.

onDeserialized.desc: Restore hook after Lua reload: puts the saved paths back.
